services.value: Provides trace level analysis of environmental samples using High Resolution Mass Spectrometry (HRMS) for dioxins, furans, and PCBs. Uses EPA methods 1613B, 8290A, and 1668C, including HRGC/HRMS approaches for dioxins/furans, PCDDs/PCDFs, and chlorinated biphenyl congeners in water, soil, sediment, biosolids, and tissue.
